## [1.4.0] - 2026-11-13

### ⚠ BREAKING CHANGES
- **Orders API:** the orders endpoint now returns prices in cents instead of decimal currency units. Clients that read price fields must be updated to divide by 100 (or handle cents directly).

### Added
- Carts are saved for logged-out users for 30 days, so shoppers can return to their cart later.
- Dark mode for the account page.

### Fixed
- Checkout total ignored the discount code on mobile.
- Search box lost focus after the first letter was typed.

### Security
- Password reset links now expire. Previously they never did.

## [2.0.0] - 2026-11-20

### Breaking Changes
- Removed the deprecated `/v1/customers` endpoint. Clients must migrate to their replacement before upgrading. (#305)

### Added
- Download invoices as PDF. (#301)
- Invite teammates by email. (#304)

### Changed
- Switched the bundler to Vite. (#310)

### Performance
- Search results load about twice as fast on large catalogues. (#308)

### Fixed
- VAT was rounded the wrong way for totals ending in .5. (#303)
- The date picker showed the wrong month in Safari. (#307)

### Security
- Uploaded files could be read by other accounts. (#309)

## [0.9.2] - 2026-12-01

### Security
- Upgrade the YAML parser to patch a remote code execution vulnerability (CVE-2026-4411). (#44)

### Added
- New `tool doctor` command checks your setup. (#42)

### Changed
- **BREAKING:** The config file is renamed from `.toolrc` to `tool.toml`. Rename existing config files to `tool.toml` to keep them working. (#41)

### Fixed
- `--quiet` no longer prints warnings. (#40)
- Crash on Windows paths that contain spaces. (#45)

## [3.2.0] - 2026-12-08

### Breaking Changes
- **API:** The trips endpoint now paginates by default, returning 50 trips per page. Clients that expect all trips in a single response must request additional pages. ([#518](https://github.com/OWNER/REPO/pull/518))

### Added
- Offline maps for saved trips. ([#515](https://github.com/OWNER/REPO/pull/515))
- Share a trip with a link that expires. ([#519](https://github.com/OWNER/REPO/pull/519))

### Removed
- The legacy trip importer. ([#524](https://github.com/OWNER/REPO/pull/524))

### Fixed
- Edits made while offline were lost after logging in. ([#517](https://github.com/OWNER/REPO/pull/517))
- Shared links exposed the owner's email address. ([#522](https://github.com/OWNER/REPO/pull/522))
- Map pins overlapped on small screens. ([#521](https://github.com/OWNER/REPO/pull/521))

## [1.11.0] - 2027-01-05

### Breaking Changes
- Dropped support for Internet Explorer 11. (#93)

### Added
- Spell check for 14 languages in the editor. (#87)
- Documents can be exported as Markdown. (#91)
- Builds are now produced for arm64. (#88)

### Fixed
- Undo skipped every second change in the editor. (#89)
- Session tokens were written to the browser console. (#90)
- Tables pasted from Excel lost their borders. (#94)

### Internal
- Raised test coverage of the export module. (#92)
- Renamed internal variables. (#95)

## [4.0.1] - 2027-01-19

### Breaking Changes
- **billing:** annual plans now renew on the purchase date instead of the 1st of the month (#702)

### Added
- **billing:** subscriptions can be paused for up to 3 months (#706)

### Fixed
- **emails:** receipts showed the wrong currency symbol (#703)
- **webhooks:** signatures are now verified, so forged webhooks are rejected (#705)
- CSV export no longer cuts off rows after 10,000 (#707)

### Documentation
- Fixed typos in CONTRIBUTING (#704)

### Internal
- Pinned the CI runner image (#701)
